newsitem.title: UK: Akhter postpones float, blames investor caution.
newsitem.headline: Akhter postpones float, blames investor caution.

text.p: UK computer network specialist Akhter Group Plc said on Friday it would postpone its stock market flotation until investor sentiment towards small and mid-capitalisation stocks had improved.

The group, which had unveiled flotation plans earlier this month, said after consultation with its financial advisers SocGen Securities the postponement would be in the interests of its employees and shareholders.
Directors at Akhter were unavailable for further comment.
Akhter, which would have been valued at between 50 and 60 million stg, had originally planned to raise 20 million stg from a float planned for July.

Brokers pointed out the FTSE SmallCap index had underperformed the FTSE 100 by 10 percent since the beginning of the year and over 20 percent in the last 12 months, making it tough for some proposed new issues.
